objective: Descend from DE26-e53e454ffc9a using two-step endpoints; try more distant layouts if local gain is below 0.001 CKT
acceptance: moving hand, S2 home and minimum 20-contract home >= original production; S2 e34 and A7E-v4 <= original production
localSelection: 112 candidates in first selected two-operation endpoint screen; at most 80 in a second screen if an admissible improvement exists
farSelection: if total local gain <0.001, up to 80 final candidates selected from 8000 seeded legal walks, >=6 token mappings away from the best local anchor
farRefinement: Descend the best selected distant endpoint for up to two further rounds, at most 64 new native-scored one-hop endpoints per round; cached neighbors participate without rescoring
scope: All operations and pairs are generated before final endpoint screening; native CKT is computed only for selected endpoints, not an exhaustive two-hop CKT proof
intermediateState: may violate memory, uniqueness, empty-bucket or ergonomic gates; final endpoint must satisfy all frozen gates
